title: Hearty Portuguese Chicken Thigh Skillet
description: A malty and savory Portuguese dish featuring chicken thighs, perfect for meal prep, with a glassy-jelly sauce, made in a mason jar. This ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly recipe is easy to make and delicious to eat.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the chicken thighs to the skillet, skin side down, and cook for 5 minutes.
Flip the chicken thighs over and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add the malt vinegar, chicken broth, paprika, salt, black pepper, and bay leaves to the skillet.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Remove the bay leaves and serve the chicken thighs with the glassy-jelly sauce spooned over the top.
